blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.upload` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method creates a new upload. It sends a request to the
[Upload Files](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#uploads\_postuploads)
API route.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the files to upload.

children.name: files
children.description: The list of files to upload.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the file.

children.name: content
children.description: The content of the file.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields and relations to retrieve in the uploaded files.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: files
children.description: The list of uploaded files.

children.name: id
children.description:
The ID of the file in the configured File Module Provider.
For example, when using the Local File Provider Module (default provider),
the ID is the file's path relative to the `static` directory.

children.name: url
children.description: The URL of the file.

[Get File](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#uploads\_getuploadsid)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the file to retrieve.

types.name: query
types.description: Query parameters to pass in the request.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: file
children.description: The file's details.

children.name: id
children.description:
The ID of the file in the configured File Module Provider.
For example, when using the Local File Provider Module (default provider),
the ID is the file's path relative to the `static` directory.

children.name: url
children.description: The URL of the file.

blocks.html:
This method deletes a file by its ID from the configured File Module Provider. It sends a request to the
[Delete File](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#uploads\_deleteuploadsid)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the file to delete.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the item that was deleted.

children.name: object
children.description: The type of the item that was deleted.

children.name: deleted
children.description: Whether the item was deleted successfully.

blocks.html:
This method creates a presigned URL for a file upload. It sends a request to the
`/admin/uploads/presigned-urls` API route.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the file to upload.

children.name: originalname
children.description: The original name of the file on the user's computer (aka clientName)

children.name: mime_type
children.description: The mime type of the file.

children.name: size
children.description: The size of the file in bytes.

children.name: access
children.description: The access level of the file.

types.name: query
types.description: Query parameters to pass in the request.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

types.name: Promise
types.description: The presigned URL for the file upload.

children.name: url
children.description: The URL to be used for uploading the file

children.name: filename
children.description:
The unique filename that can be used with the file provider
to fetch the file

children.name: originalname
children.description: The original name of the file on the user's computer (aka clientName)

children.name: mime_type
children.description: The mime type of the file.

children.name: extension
children.description: Extension of the file to be uploaded

children.name: size
children.description: Size of the file to be uploaded (in bytes)
